setup_comment: JPEG-LM project setting derived from the AVC-LM reproduction config. It uses 30 fps, preserves the full source duration, and encodes one slice per frame.
resize_mode_comment: Fit within 256x144 preserving aspect ratio, then center-pad (letterbox/pillarbox).
fps_comment: Match the inferred BSCV output rate and avoid the AVC-LM configuration's aggressive 3 fps temporal subsampling. A fixed 30 fps filter can still duplicate frames from lower-rate sources or drop frames from sources above 30 fps.
clip_duration_comment: Preserve the full source duration; no time-based truncation is applied.

ffmpeg.bitstream_filter_comment: The raw H.264 muxer already writes Annex-B, so h264_mp4toannexb is unnecessary.
